subject: Blanket PO + invoice lanes: sequencing, net terms and retro discounts
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medcurehealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medcurehealth.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Blanket PO request + invoicing lanes for Q3 work

Hi Priyom / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we liked the latency profile and the per-model cost breakdown. Procurement is ready to move forward with a 12-month blanket PO but they have some required constraints I want to surface before we draft anything: 

- PO format must follow our template (MC-YYYY-####) and include an internal release number for each project lane.
- We need the ability to invoice per "lane" (Project A / Project B) so our accounting can allocate to separate cost centers; however payments will be consolidated monthly against the blanket PO.
- MedCure requires net 60 as standard terms; our Treasury will only consider net 30 or net 45 with early-payment discounts.
- Please confirm Redwood can accept consolidated monthly invoicing with line items per lane and include your remit-to / ACH details on each invoice.
- Also, have you supported retroactive volume discounts applied at month-end? Our procurement folks like a structure where committed spend bands are reconciled monthly and any discount is applied on the next invoice.

I'm attaching the blanked PO template and a short SOW for Lane A. Can you confirm these are acceptable and provide a sample invoice mock that meets our format? If this looks feasible we'll issue an official PO once terms are aligned.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Sr. Procurement Manager | MedCure Health
elena.rossi@medcurehealth.com
Attachments: MedCure_Blanket_PO_template.pdf, MedCure_SOW_ProjectLaneA.docx

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medcurehealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Blanket PO request + invoicing lanes for Q3 work

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers up front, then a couple of asks: 

1) PO format: we can record MC-YYYY-#### in our billing system and accept a blanket PO with release lines. We'll ask finance to add the release number as the invoice reference.

2) Invoice lanes: we can produce a single consolidated monthly invoice per blanket PO and include separate line items for each lane/project (Project A / Project B), including your cost-center codes in the description. That meets the "consolidated payment, split allocation" requirement.

3) Net terms: Redwood's default for self-serve is net 30; for enterprise agreements we can support net 45 or net 60 on a case-by-case basis tied to a committed spend or a billing cadence change. If Treasury needs net 60 as a firm requirement, we can accommodate but will need to adjust the pricing/tiering to reflect higher credit exposure.

4) Retroactive discounts: yes — we support monthly reconciliations where we apply a volume/commit discount at month-end and issue a credit on the following invoice. We can also structure an on-invoice negative line item labeled "Monthly Volume Adjustment" so it appears when you reconcile.

Requests from our side: 
- Can procurement confirm whether net 60 is non-negotiable or whether MedCure will accept net 45 plus a 1.5% early-payment discount for net-30 settlements? That flexibility allows us to keep the committed-rate lower.
- Please provide an example release number pattern (e.g., MC-2026-045) so we map it 1:1.

I've attached a short Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf (high level) and mock invoice template. Laura, Ben — can you validate that our accounting team will be able to put the release id on each invoice and set up ACH/Remit?

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Exec, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf, Redwood_MockInvoice_LaneSplit.xlsx

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medcurehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Blanket PO request + invoicing lanes for Q3 work

Hi all — looping in finance details. Confirming technical billing capabilities: 

- Our billing system can accept the MC-YYYY-#### PO format and we'll place the release number into the invoice "Reference" field. Each invoice will show: PO#, Release#, Lane name, Cost center.
- We can consolidate to a single monthly invoice per PO and still export separate ledger lines per lane for your AP system to consume.
- ACH remit: Redwood prefers ACH for US customers. Remit-to details we will include on all invoices; we can also provide a Vendor W-9 upon request.
- For net 60 requests: Finance needs a signed contract + committed minimum monthly spend or a P-Card arrangement. Absent a commitment, we can offer net 45 or net 60 with a slight upward price adjustment.

One operational note: to enable retro discounts as credits, we need a reconciliation file per month (we can generate) and a single "adjustment" credit on the next invoice. This is standard and should work with your AP workflows.

Elena — if MedCure can accept a 30-day early-payment window for a 1.5% discount, we can offset most of the net60 exposure and keep the agreed unit price at the lower band. Otherwise we'll send a pricing tier for net 60.

Laura
Laura Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medcurehealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Blanket PO request + invoicing lanes for Q3 work

Thanks — that's helpful. A couple clarifications from Procurement/Treasury: 

- Net 60 is not an absolute blocker, but our legal prefers it for non-critical vendors. For strategic partners (like Redwood) Treasury will consider net 45 + 1.5% early-pay discount. I'll confirm the release number pattern — they typically use MC-2026-###.
- On-line items: we need each lane to include the MedCure cost center and project code for internal chargebacks. Your proposed ledger line export is exactly what we need.
- Can Redwood accept a single consolidated PDF invoice with metadata fields (PO, Release, Lane, Cost center) plus a machine-readable CSV export for our ERP? 

If you can confirm the CSV export + attachment format and provide the net-45 pricing tier, Procurement can draft the blanket PO and route for signature. Also include the credit mechanism for retro discounts (line item + negative amount next invoice).

Elena

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medcurehealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 14:53:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Blanket PO request + invoicing lanes for Q3 work

Elena / team —

We can do everything requested: consolidated PDF invoice, per-lane ledger lines in a CSV, release number in the reference field, and ACH remit details. A few specifics on the pricing side so Procurement can draft the PO without back-and-forth: 

- Net-45 tier (requires 12-month blanket PO + minimum committed ARR of $150k): 8% discount off list for committed usage bands; monthly reconciliation with month-end volume credits applied on next invoice.
- Net-60 option (if MedCure requires) will carry a 1.8% pricing premium relative to the net-45 tier.
- Early-payment discount: 1.5% applied if paid within 30 days (applies to net-45 invoices too). The discount is calculated on the net invoice amount after volume credits.

I'll attach a sample CSV schema and a mock PDF invoice that matches MedCure's template. If this is acceptable, Priyom — please ask Procurement to send the signed blanket PO (MC-2026-###) and we'll create a release line for Lane A so invoices can start in August.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MockInvoice_PDF.pdf, Redwood_CSV_LedgerSchema.csv
